This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a [[Chirality (mathematics)|chiral]] symmetric arrangement of six [[pentagonal prism]]s, aligned with the axes of fivefold rotational symmetry of a [[dodecahedron]].

== Related polyhedra ==
This compound shares its [[vertex arrangement]] with four [[uniform polyhedron|uniform polyhedra]] as follows:
